chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, who said:

A man complained to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about coughing, and I was present. He said to him: 'Take in your palm some kashm (lovage) and an equal amount of sugar, and swallow it for one or two days.' Ibn Udhaynah said: 'I met the man after that, and he said: I did not do it except once, and it went away (was cured).'
ai.seo_question: What was the remedy for coughing prescribed by Imam al-Sadiq (AS)?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the practical medical wisdom of Imam al-Sadiq (as), prescribing a specific remedy of lovage (*kashm*) and sugar for coughing, which proved effective even with a single application. It highlights the integration of natural remedies within Shia tradition, emphasizing the Prophet's family's holistic approach to health and their authority in diagnosing and treating physical ailments.
